title: P14 — Connect VideoML provider to local Auritus
description:
## Dispatch packet P14
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D06 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
toolchain, cli
Primary paths: src/providers/tts/auritus.ts; registry.ts; CLI setup/config. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Spawn bridge safely and implement D06 validation/timeout. Add explicit model setup/diagnostics commands and clean install docs. Default only new projects to auritus; preserve explicitly selected existing providers. Remove implicit dry-run successes from missing creds or CI.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
protocol integration with fake process; missing executable/model, stderr noise, malformed response, timeout and CI explicit-provider tests.

## Dependencies
videoml-f4f9f3 (P13), videoml-207e97 (P01)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D06 correction: reject fatal exit, not a recoverable per-request error response. A 300s timeout kills process group and fails run, removing partial outputs; no implicit restart or paid fallback.

Not accepted yet: refreshed packed-consumer verification was stopped before starting because free space was below8GiB. No setup/model download or real inference performed. Heavy operations paused; source remains uncommitted for final review and validation.
